siteBlock.Description of Business Type / Industry: Argenta Manufacturing Limited is an animal health pharmaceutical manufacturer. The company produces a wide range of bespoke animal health products for both local and export markets. Argenta is the largest animal health pharmaceutical manufacturer in the Southern Hemisphere and also provides contract manufacturing services to other businesses in OECD countries. Its Manurewa facility is GMP-certified and meets the requirements of major regulatory agencies, including the European Medicines Agency (EMA) and the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA). The site is supported by highly competent health and safety practitioners and strong compliance programmes.

siteBlock.Brief location summary: G2 Chiller is a dedicated storage area for Class 6.1B (320 kg) and Class 6.1C (2500 kg) used in veterinary medicine, primarily for cattle, sheep, goats, horses, dogs, and cats to treat and control a wide range of internal and external parasites. At this site, these hazardous substances are kept closed and are stored in a temperature-controlled cool room.
